hook: A text index adds each new letter in constant time and still answers searches in optimal time.
hook_turn: still answers searches in optimal time.
summary: The authors build the first index for pattern matching over integer alphabets that handles each appended letter in O(1) worst-case time and reports a pattern's occurrences in O(|P|+occ) time. The key is a path-decomposed suffix tree that stores paths in a dictionary instead of the full tree. The constant update time holds only with high probability, and the result is theoretical with no implementation reported.
title: Real-Time String Indexing in Optimal Time
